item.title: CNMI parents honored for leadership
item.description: CNMI parents who took meaningful leadership roles in addressing issues affecting children were recognized at the 2026 Parent Leadership Summit, hosted by the Department of Community and Cultural Affairs’ Division of Youth Services at Aqua Resort Club on Saturday. item.description: THE Make-A-Wish Foundation, along with dozens of sponsors, gathered at Crowne Plaza’s Ataari Dinner Show on Saturday to celebrate Janie Benavente and her parents, Eun and Jeremiah Benavente, and the wish that came true. item.title: CUC reports third auto-trip shutdown in February
item.description: SAIPAN experienced its third islandwide power outage in February when an “auto‑trip” shut down the Commonwealth Utilities Corp.’s power system early Friday morning, leaving businesses and residents without electricity for more than two hours.
